test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The school authorities are / decided to close the high school / wing for the next three days / due to power failure.

options.text: decided to close the high school
wing for the next three days

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"school authorities are decided"** is incorrect.
 
• The correct form should be **"school authorities have decided"** 
 
• The above phrase does not **give clarity. **It should in active sense.
 
• **For example: **
 
 
• It is decided by the school authority. (Correct)
 
• The school authorities are decided it. (Incorrect)
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence is-** *"The school authorities have decided to close the high school wing for the next three days due to power failure."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 ("due to power failure") **correctly states the reason for the action described.
 
• **Option 3 (decided to close the high school) **correctly uses the infinitive.
 
• **Option 4 ("wing for the next three days") **is grammatically correct as it specifies the duration of the action.
